Drunk.note: Either the Sailor or the alive player they chose, at the Storyteller's call.

setupPrep.none: its Drunk token marks the Sailor’s own night choice, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: Placed on a new choice each night.

reminderPlaceholders.note: Drunk goes on the Sailor or the chosen player, whichever is drunk.

full.text: The Sailor chooses a living player. Either the Sailor or that player is drunk until dusk: mark them *DRUNK*.
full.reason: Says who gets the Drunk token and when it comes off.
